title: Some bugs vanish when you look at them: heisenbugs
body: A heisenbug changes behaviour when observed, because adding logging or a debugger alters timing, memory layout or optimisation. Race conditions are the usual suspects. Its cousins classify by temperament: deterministic bohrbugs, ageing-related mandelbugs, and schroedinbugs that 'could never have worked' yet did, until someone read the code.
